facts.fact: 峡谷醒来：死树成了岩脊上的跷跷板——Kinch 在重的枝端、Galva 在根端后爬，树正缓缓倾覆
facts.anchor: the tree had become a seesaw on a ridge of rock

facts.fact: Galva 闭眼微笑呼唤 Dalgatha（战鸦与死亡女神同名）——按她的信仰两人已经完蛋了
facts.anchor: We were done and over by her lights

facts.fact: Kinch 一颗心跳的决定时间后松手；动机自问无解（牺牲还是自保？「我也不知道」）
猫坠戒指救命：他喊出 Raooo——忘了戒指、戒指没忘他（谢谢第二次机会女神 Cassa）
facts.anchor: thank Cassa, goddess of second chances, it hadn’t forgotten about me

facts.fact: 谷底见驴尸：被岩矛串住挂在头顶，内脏铺在他要攀的坡上；白枭们在上面打量
facts.anchor: the dead donkey hanging by its harness from the sharp spear of rock

facts.fact: Galva 翻开他眼皮查看后警告：头伤很重——睡了就可能醒不来
facts.anchor: If you sleep, I think you will not wake up

facts.fact: Kinch 用贼的所有权宣言命令书开口；泼灯油、亮火种——「以禁神之名烧你成灰」
facts.anchor: I command you to speak to me.

facts.fact: 书开口（Gallardian 腔）：嫌 Holtish 是鞋钉语、Galtish 是奴隶语——白舌对黑舌的阶级羞辱
facts.anchor: Only Galts speak Galtish. Why learn the language of the slave when you already speak the language of the master?

facts.fact: 书首次叫他全名：Kinch Na Shannack，你正处在精致的麻烦里；自称 bound to live and serve
facts.anchor: Kinch Na Shannack, you are in exquisite trouble.

facts.fact: 书献策捕虫草：Istrean 绿狼草实为食虫植物、胶极强——涂胶挂驴肉把白枭诱出悬崖
facts.anchor: The Istrean Greenwolf isn’t a wolf at all

facts.fact: 背叛：书用墨须附钢刃割断驴尸吊带——食物装备随白枭一同坠谷；它早有预谋
facts.anchor: A blade. It had used a blade to cut that donkey’s strap and doom us.

facts.fact: 「你这墨血的 Gallardian 贱人」——他确认书是女人：不是因为女人更邪恶，是因为它完胜了他，而女人擅长这个
facts.anchor: I knew it then to be a woman
